content.json:
# NutriForge Operations Dashboard

Real-time view of API health, SLO status, and product KPIs.

**Application Insights**: `${app_insights_name}`  
**Subscription**: `${subscription_id}`

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| summarize total=count(), errors=countif(resultCode startswith '5'), latency_p99=percentile(duration, 99), latency_p50=percentile(duration, 50) by bin(timestamp, 5m)
| extend availability=round((total - errors) * 100.0 / total, 2)
| project-rename ['Time']=timestamp, ['Total req']=total, ['5xx']=errors, ['Avail %']=availability, ['p50 (ms)']=latency_p50, ['p99 (ms)']=latency_p99
content.title: Request rate, availability & latency

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| summarize total=count(), errors=countif(resultCode startswith '5')
| extend availability=round((total - errors) * 100.0 / total, 3)
| project ['Requests']=total, ['5xx errors']=errors, ['Availability %']=availability
content.title: 28-day availability snapshot

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where url !has '/diet-plan/generate' and url !has '/assistant/'
| summarize p50=percentile(duration, 50), p95=percentile(duration, 95), p99=percentile(duration, 99), rps=count() by bin(timestamp, 5m)
| project-rename ['Time']=timestamp, ['p50 ms']=p50, ['p95 ms']=p95, ['p99 ms']=p99, ['req/5m']=rps
content.title: Non-AI endpoint latency (p50 / p95 / p99)

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where url !has '/diet-plan/generate' and url !has '/assistant/'
| summarize p99=percentile(duration, 99) by name
| top 10 by p99 desc
| project-rename ['Endpoint']=name, ['p99 (ms)']=p99
content.title: Slowest endpoints (p99)

content.query:
customMetrics
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name in ('nutriforge.diary.entries_logged', 'nutriforge.shopping_list.created', 'nutriforge.plan.generated')
| summarize total=sum(value) by name, bin(timestamp, 1h)
| project-rename ['Time']=timestamp, ['Metric']=name, ['Count']=total
content.title: Product KPI events per hour

content.query:
customMetrics
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == 'nutriforge.plan.generation_duration'
| summarize p50=percentile(value, 50), p95=percentile(value, 95), p99=percentile(value, 99) by bin(timestamp, 30m)
| project-rename ['Time']=timestamp, ['p50 (s)']=p50, ['p95 (s)']=p95, ['p99 (s)']=p99
content.title: Diet plan generation latency (s)

content.query:
customMetrics
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == 'nutriforge.plan.generated'
| summarize
    total    = sum(value),
    feasible = sumif(value, tostring(customDimensions.feasible) == 'true')
  by bin(timestamp, 1h)
| extend feasibility_pct = round(feasible * 100.0 / total, 1)
| project-rename ['Time']=timestamp, ['Total plans']=total, ['Feasible %']=feasibility_pct
content.title: Plan feasibility rate %

content.query:
customMetrics
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == 'nutriforge.ai.turns'
| summarize
    ok          = sumif(value, tostring(customDimensions.outcome) == 'ok'),
    budget_exc  = sumif(value, tostring(customDimensions.outcome) == 'budget_exceeded'),
    injection   = sumif(value, tostring(customDimensions.outcome) == 'injection')
  by bin(timestamp, 1h)
| project-rename ['Time']=timestamp, ['OK']=ok, ['Budget exceeded']=budget_exc, ['Injections blocked']=injection
content.title: Assistant turns by outcome

content.query:
customMetrics
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == 'nutriforge.ai.tokens_used'
| summarize total_tokens=sum(value) by tostring(customDimensions.type), bin(timestamp, 1h)
| project-rename ['Time']=timestamp, ['Token type']=customDimensions_type, ['Tokens']=total_tokens
content.title: AI token consumption (input vs output)

content.query:
customMetrics
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == 'nutriforge.ai.request_duration'
| summarize p50=percentile(value, 50), p95=percentile(value, 95), p99=percentile(value, 99) by bin(timestamp, 30m)
| project-rename ['Time']=timestamp, ['p50 (s)']=p50, ['p95 (s)']=p95, ['p99 (s)']=p99
content.title: Assistant turn duration (s)
